messages:
Rina: Quick UX report: on the Console with compact toolbar the FAB sits lower and bottom-right toasts bump into the toolbar shadow on 1366x768. Screenshot in thread.
Omar: Repro'd. Happens when toolbar uses `toolbar-compact-height: 40px` + FAB gap 16px. Toast default offset 16px is too small.
Paz: Two approaches: increase toast offset token, or compute offset from present UI chrome (toolbar + FAB). Prefer computed so teams don’t change density tokens.
Rina: Agreed. Maybe runtime reads `document.body.dataset.ui='toolbar,fab'` and sets `--toast-offset` before animations.
Omar: CSS var fallback: `--toast-offset: calc(var(--fab-gap,16px) + var(--toolbar-bottom-occupancy,0px) + 8px)`. Keep z-index so toasts sit above toolbar but below modal.
Paz: Accessibility: enforce `role=alert` and require text for icon-only toasts. Docs should show `aria-label="Saved: rules updated"` pattern.
design-bot: Suggested token snippet:
```
--fab-gap: 16px
--toolbar-bottom-occupancy: 0px
--toast-default-offset: 16px
--toast-computed-offset: max(var(--toast-default-offset), calc(var(--fab-gap,16px) + var(--toolbar-bottom-occupancy,0px) + 8px))
```
Rina: I'll open a small PR with runtime detection, CSS var fallback, and a Storybook story at 520px/1366 width. Can someone review the a11y copy?
Omar: I'll review. Checklist: no overlap at small heights, animations use resolved offset, icon-only toasts must include SR text.
Paz: I'll proof docs. Thanks :thumbsup:
